environment.description: Same Apollo GraphQL server deployed on GKE behind a Cloud Armor-enabled external HTTP(S) load balancer. The backend service has a security policy attached with a default DENY rule and a single priority-1000 ALLOW rule matching source ranges from the organization's internal CIDR allocations (10.128.0.0/16, 172.20.0.0/14) routed via Cloud Interconnect. Additionally, a secondary priority-900 rule permits the monitoring subnet 10.255.240.0/24. The Cloud Armor policy uses 'advancedOptionsConfig.jsonParsing: STANDARD' for request inspection. Traffic from any source outside these ranges receives a 403 response at the load balancer layer before reaching the backend. Note: the timing oracle remains in the code and the service itself binds 0.0.0.0:4000 with no application-level IP filtering.
